identity: 凝聚火行灵气于指端，催作一枚灼热火弹掷出，及地炸开一团烈焰，灼伤波及四周。最基础的火行攻击法术，凡引气入体者皆可习练。威力由灵气强度与火行极化决定，与境界、功法相关，而非苦练熟巧。

identity:
I did some work on your proposal to power the facility using RUBY LOOP in the event of continued disruptions over a long timescale and I can say that it's just not going to work.  Sure, a RUBY LOOP guy can keep their phone running basically forever, but it can't scale up.  We finally have the data on those caloric expenditures and yes, I know they don't add up and nothing makes sense, but the "how much they need to eat" and the "how much power they output" lines do not ever cross no matter what we try.  And yes, I know you're going to bring up A80, but even though she can now throw lightning bolts like an X-man her efficiency rating on power generation is not actually that high among RUBY LOOP mathematicians.  And no, before you ask, hooking up a lightning rod and having her just blast it repeatedly wouldn't generate enough power either.  I thought of it and we did try it, but no dice.

We're going to have to hope that COBALT THORN comes through if we're stuck in here for too long.
